overview: GlucoFit is a full-stack health tracking app for monitoring blood glucose and weight. Users can log readings, view trends in charts, and manage their health history. Admins get a live dashboard with user data and notifications when new entries are submitted.
features: Blood glucose logging with mg/dL and mmol/L support
Health data history with filtering and sorting
Trend charts for glucose and weight (7/14/30 day views)
Admin dashboard with real-time polling notifications
Admin users list and per-user data detail view
Secure login with role-based access (user and admin)
Responsive design with GlucoFit branding (blue + green)
